checks.label: dual-platform-ci
checks.observable_constraint: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI must provide the declared jobs and source-commit-bound terminal evidence; ordinary CI has no release credentials and final delivery is protected-gate-only.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: contract is present in SPEC/PLAN, but no CI files or terminal job evidence exists.

checks.label: list-search-canonical-cursor
checks.observable_constraint: Paged and unpaged List/Search results must be identical; cursor state must bind visible-tree digest, cursor-free query digest, stable scan position and its own digest; stale or invalid cursors return zero partial result.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: the contract is traceable, but no executable cursor evidence exists.

checks.label: per-call-credential-revalidation
checks.observable_constraint: Before Grant charge, durable authorization, turn/call increment or network, every real call must re-probe the safe backend and execute get_for_call(OPENAI); missing or unsafe credentials fail with zero increments and no automatic retry.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: the security contract is present, but no ordered execution evidence exists.

checks.label: plan-semantic-digest-v2
checks.observable_constraint: Two independent verifiers must agree on the complete PLAN identity, all normative metrics, issue list and PlanSemanticDigestV2, including private negative self-tests, with exact candidate binding.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: local Node crypto/WebCrypto agreement proves only a candidate digest; it is not the required formal independent A/B audit.

checks.label: t01-t03-toolchain-cold-start
checks.observable_constraint: A no-history agent must retrieve and follow the exact T01–T03 startup order from the approved documents; Task 1 must freeze the gate toolchain before the first behavior RED and Tasks 2–3 must consume that identity.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: no approved-input cold-start or locked toolchain evidence exists.

checks.label: task-2-loopback-oci-round-trip
checks.observable_constraint: A credential-free registry must bind only to 127.0.0.1 on an assigned port; local OCI manifest, registry RepoDigest and digest pull must have identical raw manifest bytes, with no self-reference and complete cleanup; Task 34 may only reproduce it.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: the loopback/OCI contract is present, but no observed round-trip or GO evidence exists.

checks.label: ghcr-protected-release-gate
checks.observable_constraint: Task 34 and WP36/T36.2 perform no real release; only after final source_commit freeze and same-SHA CI success may T37.1 use protected credentials for GitHub Release, GHCR and Render operations.
checks.reviewer_conclusion: FAIL: ownership is internally consistent, but no protected release-gate or external-operation evidence exists.
